figures.caption: Fig. 1. Illustration of Signal Submersion and SAGE. The self-attention mechanism assigns dominant weights to global functional context (𝑠𝑙 ), causing the sparse vulnerability features (𝑣𝑙 ) to be diluted during aggregation. SAGE addresses this by using a Sparse Autoencoder (SAE) to amplify the submerged vulnerability signal from the functional background.
